I.A. No.12588 of 2024 is an application under Section 389(1) of the Cr.P.C/430 of B.N.S.S. for suspension of sentence and grant of bail to appellant arising out of judgment dated 23.03.2022 delivered in SPL Case No.20/2018 passed by Special Judge, POCSO Act, 2012, District- Umaria (M.P.).

entities.text: Special Judge, POCSO Act, 2012, District- Umaria
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: First application was dismissed on merit vide order dated 18.10.2023.

The appellant has been convicted for the offence under Section 363, 366, 376(2)(Dha), 376(2)(Jha)
of IPC and sentenced to undergo nil, R.I. for 03 years with fine of Rs.1,000/-, R.I. for 10 years with fine of Rs.1,000/- & R.I. for 10 years with fine of Rs.1,000/- respectively and under Section 5(tha)
r/w Section 6 of the POCSO Act, 2012 with default stipulations.

Learned counsel for appellant has submitted that this is a matter of consent and the age of victim was above 18 years at the time of incident and trial Court had not considered this point and when first application was decided, this fact was not raised before the Court.

Learned counsel for appellant has further submitted that Principal Banshulal Rautel (PW-1) has clearly stated that he recorded the date of birth on the basis of Transfer Certificate issued by the school but in which 2 CRA-3086-2022 previous school the victim studied, is not known to him.

Mother of victim (PW-7) in para 4 of her statement has stated that birth certificate of victim was not obtained and she had not gone to school to get admit in the school and father went to get admit in the school and date of birth of the victim was recorded on the basis of assumption.

She has also submitted that father of victim (PW-3) who got admitted the victim in the school has stated in para 10 of his statement that he did not know the date of birth of the victim and victim was born from the first husband of his wife and first husband is still alive and when the victim's mother came to reside with her, victim was of 8 years age and
further stated that 4 to 5 years of age and just after the birth of victim, tubectomy operation was done to the mother of victim.

As per School record, on 06.12.2010 the victim was admitted in the school in Class -3 and victim's elder sister was also admitted in Class-3, thus, the age was recorded on the assumption whereas Dr.
Volga Kaithwar (PW-5) has clearly stated in para 3 that a girl who comes at the age of 15 to 16 years,

sentences.text: her auxiliary hair and pubic hair are of brown color and in the para 4 has stated that areola was of dark black colour and in the cross - examination it is admitted that generally areola get black colour on the age of 18 years.

On that basis learned counsel for appellant has submitted that age of victim was above 18 years and she was major and on her own volition she had accompanied with the appellant and consensual relations were made, hence, no criminal case is made out and prayed that application be allowed and appellant be released on bail.
Learned counsel for objection has opposed the prayer.

Learned counsel for State has also opposed the prayer and has submitted that first application was decided on merit and PW-6 has supported the case of prosecution and date of birth as mentioned in Ex.P-2 is 08.07.2002 thus on the date of incident, the victim was approximately 16 years old and consent of minor has no value, hence, the application be rejected.
Heard the parties and perused the record.
Considering the facts and circumstances of the case but without commenting anything on merits of the case, I.A. No.12588 of 2024 is allowed.

Subject to depositing the fine amount, if not already deposited, the remaining jail sentence of the appellant Vikram Kol is hereby suspended and it is directed that the appellant be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court with a further direction to appear before the Trial Court on 24.04.2025 and also on such other dates, as may be fixed by the Court in this regard during the pendency of this appeal.
All the pending IAs are closed.
Appeal is admitted for final hearing.
List the matter for final hearing in due course.
C.c. as per rules.
